const int N=2e6+10, Mod=1e9+7, mod=998244353, B=1000000;

inline int MOD(reg int x) { return (x%mod+mod)%mod; }

void explore1(reg int x, reg int len) {
    ++idx;
    v[len].push_back(MOD(idx - x));
    (sum[len] += v[len].back()) %= Mod;
    if (len == 6) return;
    for (reg int i=0; i<10; i++) explore1(x*10+i, len+1);
}

void explore2(reg int x) {

    if (x*B + (B-1) <= n && x*B*10 > n) {
        reg int now=idx;
        for (reg int i=0, mul=1; i<=6; i++, mul=mul*10) {
            reg int sz = v[i].size();
            reg int d = MOD(now - x*mul);
            reg int pos = lower_bound(v[i].begin(), v[i].end(), mod - d) - v[i].begin();
            ans = (ans + d*sz + sum[i] - mod*(sz - pos)) % Mod;
            idx += sz;
        }
        return;
    }
    ++idx;
    ans = (ans + MOD(idx - x)) % Mod;
    for (reg int i=0; i<10; i++) explore2(x*10+i);

    n=read();
    explore1(0,0);
    for (reg int i=0; i<=6; i++) sort(v[i].begin(), v[i].end());
